title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - Payment
description: The Payment resource represents a performed payment. It contains both information about the payment and the payment method used to perform it. (TM Forum TMF676 Payment 4.0.0, Swagger definition Payment; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:Payment:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Payment'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF676_PaymentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF676-Payment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Payment/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:Payment:<tmfId>. Unique identifier of Payment

href.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF676_PaymentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF676-Payment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Payment/properties/href'. Hypertext Reference of the Payment

authorizationCode.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF676_PaymentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF676-Payment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Payment/properties/authorizationCode'. Authorization code retrieved from an external payment gateway that could be used for conciliation

correlatorId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF676_PaymentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF676-Payment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Payment/properties/correlatorId'. Unique identifier in the client for the payment in case it is needed to correlate

description.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF676_PaymentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF676-Payment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Payment/properties/description'. Text describing the contents of the payment

name.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF676_PaymentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF676-Payment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Payment/properties/name'. Screen name of the payment

paymentDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF676_PaymentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF676-Payment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Payment/properties/paymentDate'. Date when the payment was performed

statusDate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF676_PaymentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF676-Payment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Payment/properties/statusDate'. Date when the status was recorded

account.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF676_PaymentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF676-Payment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Payment/properties/account'. Account reference. A account may be a party account or a financial account.

amount.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF676_PaymentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF676-Payment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Payment/properties/amount'. Amount to be paid (net of taxes)

channel.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF676_PaymentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF676-Payment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Payment/properties/channel'. The channel to which the resource reference to. e.g. channel for selling product offerings, channel for opening a trouble ticket etc..

payer.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF676_PaymentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF676-Payment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Payment/properties/payer'. Related Entity reference. A related party defines party or party role linked to a specific entity.

paymentItem.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF676_PaymentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF676-Payment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Payment/properties/paymentItem'. The paymentItem is the result of lettering process. It enables to assign automatically or manually part of incoming payment amount to a bill

paymentMethod.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF676_PaymentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF676-Payment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Payment/properties/paymentMethod'. link to the resource that holds information about the payment mean used to complete the operation. In TMF this is a PaymentMethodRefOrValue object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced PaymentMethod entity (urn:ngsi-ld:PaymentMethod:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

totalAmount.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF676_PaymentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF676-Payment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Payment/properties/totalAmount'. Amount to be paid (including taxes)

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF676_PaymentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF676-Payment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Payment/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF676_PaymentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF676-Payment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Payment/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF676_PaymentManagement/blob/v4.0.0/TMF676-Payment-v4.0.0.swagger.json#/definitions/Payment/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'Payment' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class entity name
